title: Aromatic Moroccan Fava Beans Bissara
description: Tangy and shaggy fava bean bisara enriched with sesame butter and smoky spices, perfect for a date-night Moroccan meal.
instructions: Rinse the drained fava beans under cold water.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic, ground cumin, ground coriander, and smoked paprika, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the vegetable broth and add the fava beans, bringing the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce the heat and let the bisara simmer uncovered for 15 minutes to develop flavor.
Remove the pot from the heat and use an immersion blender to puree the bisara until smooth.
Return the pot to the stove, stir in the sesame butter and lemon juice, and season with salt to taste.
Heat the mixture over low heat, stirring occasionally, until it reaches a steaming temperature.
Transfer the bisara to serving bowls, drizzle a little extra olive oil, and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
Sprinkle a pinch of smoked paprika over the garnish for an extra smoky note.
